assessment: This important study of regulatory elements and gene expression in the craniofacial region of the fat-tailed dunnart shows that, compared to placental mammals, marsupial craniofacial tissue develops in a precocious manner, with enhancer regulatory elements as primary driver of this difference. The compelling data, including a new dunnart genome assembly, provide an invaluable reference for future mammalian evolution studies, especially once additional developmental time point for the fat-tailed dunnart become available.
